facts.question: Which Strong Bad Email contains the Trogdor drawing lesson?
What year does the official site list for dragon?
Who teaches the dragon drawing lesson?
facts.answer: Strong Bad. Naturally, he considers himself the expert.

facts.question: What is the dragon's full name?
Which character does Strong Bad imagine in japanese cartoon?
What comic does Strong Bad introduce in the email comic?
Whose email show surprises Strong Bad in email thunder?
facts.answer: Homestar Runner's. Homestar has been checking email too.

facts.question: Who shares a convention booth with Strong Bad in Trogdor Con '97?
What Trogdor birthday does Happy 20th Trogday! celebrate?
facts.answer: His twentieth birthday. The official site lists the cartoon under 2023.

facts.question: Do players cooperate in Trogdor!! The Board Game?
facts.answer: Yes. Players work together and take turns controlling Trogdor.

facts.question: How many people can play Trogdor!! The Board Game?
Which three cartoon characters appear in the official board game how-to video?
facts.answer: Strong Bad, Strong Sad, and Homestar Runner.

jokes.title: Arm Budget
jokes.text: One beefy arm. Six candy bags. Clearly, the weak link is the bags.

jokes.title: The Bowl
jokes.text: Trogdor ate the candy bowl. Not the candy. The bowl. He has priorities.

jokes.title: Judges
jokes.text: They asked Trogdor to judge the costume contest. He burninated the judges. Everybody wins.

jokes.title: Costume Tip
jokes.text: Halloween tip. Dress up as Trogdor and you get extra candy. Mostly because people want you to leave.

jokes.title: Dragon Man
jokes.text: Trogdor was a man. I mean, he was a dragon man. ... Mostly he was hungry.

jokes.title: Email
jokes.text: I emailed Trogdor about sharing the candy. He replied with a picture of fire. I think that is a no.

stories.title: The Great Porch Campaign
stories.text: Trogdor approached the cardboard castle. One beefy arm flexed. The drawbridge fell over politely. Inside waited a candy bowl and a note requesting excellent manners. He announced imaginary burnination, supplied his own tiny whoosh, and said please. Total conquest. Everybody got candy. The castle received a sticker.

stories.title: The Doodle Inspector
stories.text: Homestar brought a dragon drawing to the porch. It looked suspiciously like a sandwich. Strong Bad inspected one corner. A consummate V. Acceptable. Trogdor stamped the paper with his single beefy arm. The stamp said NICE TRY in enormous letters. Homestar bowed. The sandwich won best costume.
